name: dev.ocean/chrome-devtools
description: Control the owner's real, signed-in Chrome: tabs, navigation, clicks, forms, uploads, screenshots, console and network errors. Reads every open tab and acts inside any signed-in session of the attached Chrome, for every client wired to it. The filesystem permission is declared for consent but not enforced at runtime.

server.name: dev.ocean/chrome-devtools
server.description: Chrome DevTools MCP attached to the owner's running Chrome. Usage statistics and CrUX lookups are off, so page URLs stay on this machine.
